# `missing-struct-field`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: semantic · Profile: none · Default: error · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a struct initializer that omits required fields without defaults.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An incomplete initializer cannot construct the promised value and often
indicates that a type change was not propagated to its callers.

## When it fires

It applies only when the result type and required field set are proven;
anonymous or unresolved initializers are not guessed.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Point = struct { x: i32, y: i32 };

pub fn main() void {
    const p: Point = .{ .x = 1 };
    _ = p;
}
```
